name: Soundscape
description: Listen to the live Soundscape archive: public field recordings, current popularity, and real locations loaded directly from the backend.
crossPromoDescription: Live field recordings from real places, with an interactive map and audio player.
llmsDescription: Soundscape is a live public archive of field recordings anchored to real locations. The /sound/ page loads current recordings and rankings from the Soundscape backend, while the /soundscape/ application owns accounts, recording, and publishing.
